verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS terminal. The only evidence touching retention is that its `.profile` startup script can be used to clean up temporary files (gh-23), and that users manage files locally with standard file operations (docs-6). There is no documented retention policy or deletion control for app data. Missing for 10: documented data-retention policy, explicit controls to clear command history and bookmarks, statement on whether any data leaves the device, independent corroboration.
